phrases.catalan: Sent la connexió, amb cada so.

phrases.english: Listen to the rhythm, of Catalan speech.

A pig, roots in the mud.
The duck, paddles on the lake.
Hold on, this language, it's yours.
Don't shy away, just speak it.
Each word, a new path, open.

phrases.english: Read the sentence, feel the emotion.

phrases.english: Ask a question, get an answer.

phrases.english: Listen well, and absorb it all.
Embrace the journey, step by step.
phrases.catalan: Abraça el viatge, pas a pas.

phrases.english: Speak a word, feel the warmth.

phrases.catalan: La teva presència, una brisa suau.
